key_insight: topas-editor and TOPilot turn TOPAS crystallography workflows into AI-assisted, syntax-aware, and largely automatable analysis pipelines.
engineering_relevance: The tools can speed up diffraction and total scattering analysis by reducing manual scripting, guiding users through complex refinements, and enabling repeatable workflows across multiple data types.
method: topas-editor: a VS Code extension with TOPAS-aware editing, hover tips, and manual links
TOPilot: Python routines plus machine-readable reference docs for AI-driven TOPAS automation
Demonstrated on Rietveld refinement, multi-dataset analysis, structure solution, phase ID, incommensurate structures, and PDF fitting
evidence_signal: The abstract reports successful demonstrations across several challenging crystallographic workflows, including complex refinements and automated analysis of multiple datasets.
watch_item: Performance depends on correct TOPAS syntax/context and on the chosen AI model, so outputs still need expert validation.
paper_title: topas-editor and TOPilot: tools for AI-driven analysis of diffraction and total scattering data
